steps.title: Analyze and Plan 3D UI Architecture
steps.description: Formulate a skeuomorphic 3D design paradigm using nested native gradient assets, deep offset layers, and physical press states.

steps.title: Clean Dependencies in Build Configuration
steps.description: Refactor app/build.gradle to remove third-party dependencies and optimize packaging blocks for safe compilation under AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Validate Android Manifest & Namespace
steps.description: Double-check the standard Android namespace and activity definitions to guarantee optimal OS-level initialization.

steps.title: Establish 3D Color Shadows & HSV Depth Formulas
steps.description: Implement helper algorithms in MainActivity to dynamically calculate perfect shaded depth layers for buttons, cards, and grid items.

steps.title: Design Tactile 3D StateList Drawables
steps.description: Craft programmatic state-responsive LayerDrawables which offset components downwards on touch, mimicking physical buttons.

steps.title: Enhance the Alphabet Learn Grid in 3D
steps.description: Rebuild the custom Alphabet adapter grid to output chunky 3D letter tiles that push down dynamically under touch.

steps.title: Build the 3D Pop-up Detail Sheet
steps.description: Upgrade the overlay dialog card into an elegant, floating skeuomorphic block with tactile closing and navigation triggers.

steps.title: Inject 3D Buttons in Quiz Game View
steps.description: Convert quiz choice options into thick, touch-reactive physical blocks to reward user interactive gameplay.

steps.title: Redesign Tracing Mode Frame in 3D
steps.description: Structure the custom DrawingView panel with a recessed, thick-inset frame simulating realistic canvas depth.

steps.title: Optimize Bottom Navigation Pills
steps.description: Apply the 3D tactile state machine to the bottom navigation bar so selected modes stand out with physical depth heights.

steps.title: Compile and Build Alphabet Explorer
steps.description: Execute the Gradle assembleDebug task to output a flawless, high-performance 3D skeuomorphic learning app.
